page_title: ALA 1-0 MAL | Alaves v Mallorca 01/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
90+3' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+3' Jose Copete (Mallorca) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+3' Leo Roman was forced into action to thwart Carlos Martin (Alaves). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
90+2' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
90+2' Substitution. Kike Garcia leaves the pitch and is replaced by Toni Martinez (Alaves).
90+1' Here is a change. Abderrahmane Rebbach is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Martin (Alaves).
90+1' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.

90' So close! Sergi Darder (Mallorca) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
89' A clumsy foul by Antonio Blanco (Alaves) and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle. Mallorca have a free kick.
87' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
84' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
82' Manu Morlanes picks out Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) with a lofted pass into the centre of the box, but his header rises just over the crossbar.
80' That will be all from Jon Guridi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Stoichkov (Alaves).
79' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
79' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Luna (Mallorca) replacing Daniel Rodriguez.
79' Omar Mascarell goes off the pitch and Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on.
78' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera was alert and made an astonishing save!
76' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. The ball rebounds to Jon Guridi (Alaves) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
71' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
69' The substitution is prepared. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Robert Navarro.
68' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Cyle Larin and he is replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
67' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Leo Roman intercepts the ball.
66' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:4. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
61' Alaves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
60' The ball breaks to Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) works the corner short.

60' What a great chance for Abdel Abqar (Alaves). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

60' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.
59' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
57' A substitution has been made. Chiquinho goes off and Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) comes on.
56' The free kick evades the keeper and presents Cyle Larin (Mallorca) with an almost open goal, but he somehow heads high over the bar from close in.
54' Ander Guevara (Alaves) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Kike Garcia, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
53' Chiquinho (Mallorca) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
52' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
50' The attendance for today's match is 17212.
50' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just over the bar.
48' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) swings in a cross from the corner, but Leo Roman reads it well and gathers the ball.
47' This shall not pass! Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' It's like he was asking for a caution. Abdel Abqar (Alaves) receives a yellow card.
40' The resulting corner from Jon Guridi (Alaves) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
40' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Alaves get a corner.
38' A player from Alaves commits a rough challenge. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick to Mallorca.
36' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has finally had enough of Luis Garcia Plaza and brandishes a yellow card at him!
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adrian Pica (Alaves) was quite harsh and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' It could have been a good chance to score! Carlos Vicente (Alaves) fails to release Kike Garcia with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
30' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

29' Cyle Larin is picked out by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca), but one of the defenders arrives to clear. Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
29' Toni Lato (Mallorca) sends a long ball in, but Antonio Sivera comfortably gathers the ball.
28' 4:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
24' Chiquinho (Mallorca) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
23' Antonio Sivera is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca). Easy save!
22' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
19' An attempted cross from Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is cleared.
19' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for an infringement.
17' Luis Garcia Plaza is forced to make a change. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) is unable to continue due to injury, Ander Guevara comes on.
15' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
14' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
11' Kike Garcia (Alaves) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
7' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
4' Carlos Vicente pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Adrian Pica (Alaves) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
4' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Carlos Vicente (Alaves). Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
3' A spell of possession for Mallorca in an attempt to control the game.
1' The first half has just begun.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes will supervise the game today.
